raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# Description

`get_attention_backend` disables FlashAttention 2 for padded head dims in (192, 256] unless the device is in an exact allowlist, `((8, 0), (9, 0), (10, 0), (12, 0))`. sm103 (B300 / GB300) is not in it. So on sm103, every config with `max(head_dim_qk, head_dim_v)` in (192, 256] falls back to FusedAttention or UnfusedDotProductAttention, even when flash-attn is installed and requested. Examples are head_dim 256, or MLA with head_dim_v 256.

This is a regression:
- #2836 (merged 2026-06-04) removed the allowlist.
- #2629 (merged 2026-06-05) restored it in the hunk that added padded Q/V head dims.

#3360 reported the same problem on B300 and was closed by its author. As discussed there, this PR is the narrower fix: it adds only `(10, 3)` and leaves sm86/sm89 out.

The fallback also defeats an existing preference. For THD with dropout on `(10, 0)` and `(10, 3)`, `is_slow_fused_thd_dropout` disables FusedAttention so that FA2 is used. On sm103 with head_dim > 192, FA2 was already disabled by the allowlist, so the preference never applies.

Why a list entry rather than dropping the clause: flash-attn's hdim256 backward picks its kernel by opt-in shared memory per block. Below 144 KB (sm86/sm89/sm120 have 99 KB) it launches no kernel at all when dropout is enabled (Dao-AILab/flash-attention#3053). sm103 has 227 KB, the same as sm90 and sm100, so it takes the same backward kernel as sm100. The existing `(12, 0)` entry has that problem with dropout. It is tracked in #3711 and fixed separately.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Changes

- Add `(10, 3)` to the FA2 head_dim > 192 allowlist. Update the debug message from "sm80/90/100+" (which wrongly suggested every sm100+ device) to "sm80/90/100/103/120".
- Add `test_fa2_large_head_dim_backend_selection` to `tests/pytorch/attention/test_attention_backend_selection.py`. It mocks the compute capability and the flash-attn version, like the FA4 cases in that file. It covers:
  - sm103 with padded head dim 224, 256, and MLA 192/256: FA2 is selected;
  - the 192 boundary, 264 (> 256) and 252 (not a multiple of 8): FA2 is not selected;
  - an sm100 control.

## Testing

- New test against unpatched `utils.py`: `sm103-d256`, `sm103-d224` and `sm103-mla-padded-d256` fail; the other 4 pass.
- New test with the patch: 7/7 pass. Whole `test_attention_backend_selection.py`: 35 passed, 2 skipped (the existing SM12x-GPU tests).
- Together with the #3711 fix, the whole file gives 43 passed, 2 skipped. The two changes touch separate hunks.
- How the tests ran: these tests need no GPU, so they ran in a process with no visible GPU. That process used a source build of TE at `9d9bd9e5` with this branch's Python sources on top. The attention selector and its tests are unchanged between `9d9bd9e5` and this branch's base `a7b6c0cb`.
- `black` 24.4.2 with the repository's pre-commit arguments reports no changes.
- I have not run FA2 at head_dim 256 on sm103 hardware. This PR changes backend selection only.

# Checklist:

- [x] I have read and followed the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
- [x] The functionality is complete
- [x] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [x] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [x] My changes generate no new warnings
- [x] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [x] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

@@ -122,6 +122,53 @@ def test_fa4_d256_seqused_backend_selection(monkeypatch, version, backward, expe
     assert bool(available[0]) is expected
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "capability,head_dims,expect_flash",
+    [
+        pytest.param((10, 3), (256, 256), True, id="sm103-d256"),
+        pytest.param((10, 3), (224, 224), True, id="sm103-d224"),
+        pytest.param((10, 3), (192, 256), True, id="sm103-mla-padded-d256"),
+        pytest.param((10, 3), (192, 192), True, id="sm103-d192"),
+        pytest.param((10, 3), (264, 264), False, id="sm103-d264"),
+        pytest.param((10, 3), (252, 252), False, id="sm103-d252-unaligned"),
+        pytest.param((10, 0), (256, 256), True, id="sm100-d256"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_fa2_large_head_dim_backend_selection(monkeypatch, capability, head_dims, expect_flash):
+    """FA2 padded head_dim > 192 is selected on sm100-class GPUs, including sm103."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("NVTE_FLASH_ATTN_V2", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("NVTE_FLASH_ATTN_V4", "0")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dpa_utils, "get_device_compute_capability", lambda device: capability)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dpa_utils, "get_cudnn_version", lambda: (9, 26, 0))
+    fa2_version = PkgVersion("2.8.3")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dpa_utils.FlashAttentionUtils, "is_installed", True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dpa_utils.FlashAttentionUtils, "version", fa2_version)
+    for flag in (
+        "v2_plus",
+        "v2_1_plus",
+        "v2_3_plus",
+        "v2_4_plus",
+        "v2_4_1_plus",
+        "v2_5_plus",
+        "v2_5_7_plus",
+        "v2_6_0_plus",
+        "v2_7_0_plus",
+    ):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(dpa_utils.FlashAttentionUtils, flag, True)
+    params = dpa_utils.AttentionParams(
+        device=torch.device("cuda:0"),
+        qkv_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        qkv_layout="bshd_bshd_bshd",
+        head_dim_qk=head_dims[0],
+        head_dim_v=head_dims[1],
+        attn_mask_type="causal",
+    )
+    flash, selected_version, _, _, _, available = dpa_utils.get_attention_backend(params)
+    assert bool(flash) is expect_flash
+    assert selected_version == (fa2_version if expect_flash else None)
+    assert bool(available[0]) is expect_flash
+
+
